description: chat.rs lines 309-310: let kind = serde_json::from_value(Value::String(kind_str.clone())).unwrap_or(ChatKind::Other(kind_str.clone())). kind_str is cloned twice: once to build the Value::String for from_value, and again for the fallback ChatKind::Other. The idiom that avoids the double-clone is to match from_value(Value::String(kind_str)) which consumes kind_str, and in the Err branch reconstruct — but that does not work directly. Alternative: parse from the already-borrowed &str using serde_json::from_str("\"{kind_str}\"") or a custom FromStr impl. At minimum the comment should acknowledge that two allocations happen, or the code should be restructured to avoid one of them by moving kind_str into the Err arm via a match rather than using unwrap_or.
title: chat.rs ChatKind double-clone: kind_str cloned twice in parse+fallback
